mapper.select: SELECT o.ICATE_NO, o.READER_TY, o.READER_ID, o.INHERIT_YN, o.SINS_DT, o.SINS_ID, CASE o.READER_TY WHEN 'DEPT' THEN (SELECT g.ORGNZT_NM FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO g WHERE g.ORGNZT_ID = o.READER_ID) WHEN 'USER' THEN (SELECT u.USER_NM FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u WHERE u.ESNTL_ID = o.READER_ID) END AS READER_NM, (SELECT c.SNAME FROM TB_CATE c WHERE c.ICATE_NO = o.ICATE_NO) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_CATE_READER o WHERE o.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} ORDER BY o.READER_TY, READER_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CATE_READER (ICATE_NO, READER_TY, READER_ID, INHERIT_YN, SINS_DT, SINS_ID) VALUES ( #{cateNo}, #{readerTy}, #{readerId}, NVL(#{inheritYn}, 'Y'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{insId} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMVNUSERMASTER WHERE ESNTL_ID = #{esntlId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.ESNTL_ID AS "esntlId", u.USER_ID AS "userId", u.USER_NM AS "userNm", (SELECT g.ORGNZT_NM FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO g WHERE g.ORGNZT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID) AS "orgnztNm" FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u WHERE UPPER(u.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY u.USER_NM, u.USER_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20

SELECT o.SGUBUN_ID, o.READER_TY, o.READER_ID, o.SINS_DT, o.SINS_ID, CASE o.READER_TY WHEN 'DEPT' THEN (SELECT g.ORGNZT_NM FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO g WHERE g.ORGNZT_ID = o.READER_ID) WHEN 'USER' THEN (SELECT u.USER_NM FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u WHERE u.ESNTL_ID = o.READER_ID) END AS READER_NM FROM TB_GUBUN_READER o WHERE o.SGUBUN_ID = #{gubunId} ORDER BY o.READER_TY, READER_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GUBUN_READER (SGUBUN_ID, READER_TY, READER_ID, SINS_DT, SINS_ID) VALUES ( #{gubunId}, #{readerTy}, #{readerId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{insId} )
mapper.sql: r.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT a.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE a START WITH a.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR a.IREF = a.ICATE_NO ) AND ( r.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} OR r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DUAL WHERE ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g WHERE g.SGUBUN_ID = ( SELECT c.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_CATE c WHERE c.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE AND ( ( r.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r.READER_ID = #{esntlId} ) OR ( r.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r.READER_ID = #{orgnztId} ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE g2.SGUBUN_ID = ( SELECT c2.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_CATE c2 WHERE c2.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo} ) AND ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{esntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{orgnztId} ) ) )

SELECT c.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE c WHERE ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT a.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE a START WITH a.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR a.IREF = a.ICATE_NO ) AND ( r.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO OR r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g WHERE g.SGUBUN_ID = c.SGUBUN_ID ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT a.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE a START WITH a.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR a.IREF = a.ICATE_NO ) AND ( r.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO OR r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) AND ( ( r.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r.READER_ID = #{esntlId} ) OR ( r.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r.READER_ID = #{orgnztId} ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE g2.SGUBUN_ID = c.SGUBUN_ID AND ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{esntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{orgnztId} ) ) )

SELECT p2.IPROM_NO FROM TB_PROM p2 WHERE p2.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT p.ILAW_ID FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT c.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE c WHERE ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT a.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE a START WITH a.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR a.IREF = a.ICATE_NO ) AND ( r.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO OR r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g WHERE g.SGUBUN_ID = c.SGUBUN_ID ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT a.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE a START WITH a.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO CONNECT BY PRIOR a.IREF = a.ICATE_NO ) AND ( r.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO OR r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) AND ( ( r.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r.READER_ID = #{esntlId} ) OR ( r.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r.READER_ID = #{orgnztId} ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE g2.SGUBUN_ID = c.SGUBUN_ID AND ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{esntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{orgnztId} ) ) ) ) )
